title: Yuanjing Integrated Urban Management Platform
summary: China Unicom's Yuanjing platform uses AI for dispatch, monitoring and event management, and the company reports a 25% improvement in urban management efficiency.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: China Unicom describes AI dispatch, monitoring and event management for cities in its Yuanjing platform. In the 2025 report of the International Telecommunication Union (ITU), current as of June 2025, China Unicom states that the platform produced a 25% improvement in urban management efficiency in practical applications. The report names no city or measurement method for this figure, and it lists its deployment sites as private. No source measures a change in city services for residents.
purpose: Help municipalities detect issues, dispatch resources, and respond to residents.

ratings.reason: China Unicom reports a 25% improvement in urban management efficiency, which amounts to time and labor saved by city operators. The report names no city or measurement method for the figure.
Residents are intended to receive faster responses to requests, but no source reports a realized change for residents.
China Unicom intends cities to become more inclusive and resource-efficient, and no source reports a measured change.
